chronology_evidence.paper: States equal 40 ps sampling over final 40 ns of each of five runs; does not give the archived DCD run-to-frame mapping.
chronology_evidence.original_author_example: Loads Q99.dcd as reference ensemble and Q75/Q80/Q85/Q90/Q95 as five other ensembles. No trajectory assembly or run-boundary script.
chronology_evidence.current_author_ubiquitin_script: States frames come from continuous trajectories, but loads all Q99 frames as one ensemble and never identifies original runs or boundaries.
chronology_evidence.current_author_convergence_script: Computes contiguous prefixes of the 5000-frame Q99 ensemble as a single trajectory. This is not a map to the five original simulation runs.
